findings.location: Paragraph quoting Hebrews 10:25 (source.html near: "Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together...")
findings.source_quote: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching –Hebrews 10:25.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the current Hebrew quotation with a faithful translation of the printed English verse, preserving the reference. For example: «לֹא נִתְעַלֵּם מִהִתְכַּנְּסוֹתֵינוּ כְּמוֹ אֲשֶׁר לְחָלִיפוֹת; אֶלָּא לְעֹדֵד אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ, וְכָךְ יָרְבֶּה זֶה כְּשֶׁתִּרְאוּ אֶת־הַיּוֹם קָרוֹב» – העבר את הפסוק לעברית נאמנה לשפת המקור ושמור את מספר הפסוק (Hebrews 10:25). Ensure the Hebrew wording conveys the same meaning as the English printed source and remove the present corrupted text.
findings.translation_quote: וְלֹא־נָעִיר אֶת־מִקְהַלֵּנוּ בְּזֶה הַדָּבָר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲנָשִׁים; וּלְהָעִיר אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וּכְכָךְ הָרַע הַקָּרוֹב יִהְיֶה לָכֶם יָתֵר — ע Hebrews 10:25.

findings.location: Paragraph about Elijah (source.html near: "...then with a widow in Zarephath.")
findings.source_quote: During that time, Elijah spent time in the wilderness and then with a widow in Zarephath.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the place name using the standard biblical Hebrew form without creating ambiguity with the modern country name. Replace "בצרפת" with the conventional biblical Hebrew name "בְּצָרְפַת (צָרְפַת)" or "בצָרְפַת (Zarephath)" so it is clearly the ancient town rather than the modern country France.
findings.translation_quote: "בתקופה ההיא שהה אליהו במדבר ואז אצל אלמנה בצרפת."

findings.location: Paragraph about Mt. Carmel (source.html near: "he challenged the prophets of Baal to a match on Mt. Carmel")
findings.source_quote: Then came a time when he challenged the prophets of Baal to a match on Mt. Carmel and won a decisive victory for God.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the redundant/incorrect phrasing "הר ההר Horeb"/"הר הרי Carmel". Use a standard Hebrew name and phrasing: e.g. replace "הר הרי Carmel" or "הר הרי Carmel" with "ההר הכרמל" or "הר הכרמל" to correctly render 'Mt. Carmel'.
findings.translation_quote: "...הוא אתגר את נביאי הבעל בזינוק על הר הרי Carmel וניצח ניצחון מכריע לשם ה'."

findings.location: Paragraph introducing the Greek term (source.html near: "The Greek word translated 'fellowship'...")
findings.source_quote: The Greek word translated fellowship in the New Testament is 'Koinonia' ...
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Hebrew description of the Greek term. Replace the incorrect word "הילקוט היווני" with a proper phrase such as "המילה היוונית" or "המונח היווני". Also consider using a consistent transliteration: either 'קοινωνία' (koinōnía) or 'קואינוניה' but keep one form throughout.
findings.translation_quote: "הילקוט היווני שתורגם כ־fellowship בברית החדשה הוא „קואינוניה“ (Koinonia),..."
